paper_claim: Industrial anomaly VLM reasoning should be localization-guided rather than full-image only.
Localization-guided VLM evidence is complementary to detector baselines.
The proposed localization-guided route is stronger than the fixed WinCLIP protocol used in this study.
Candidate quality calibration is the main effective method component.
Adaptive consistency is a conservative refinement, not the main source of improvement.
Fixed Q+C fusion is diagnostic only and should not be the final method.
Same-set fusion is an upper-bound diagnostic, not a fair main result.
The method is a reliability-calibrated recognition framework, not a complete anomaly understanding system.
Do not claim pixel-level segmentation SOTA.
